A1.why: Main list is short and mostly descriptive; insights add some synthesis but limited non-obvious takeaways per paragraph.

A2.why: All main-list items link to primary sources (arXiv/Hugging Face) and all URLs returned HTTP 200/3xx in head-check.

A3.why: Items skew toward vision datasets and low-level vision; only partial overlap with focus on agents/evals/rag/long context.

A4.why: "What changed" is present but functions as a "new today" list; it does not show movement vs yesterday beyond being new.

A5.why: 3 high-signal last-24h stories relevant to agents/evals/long-context were found outside the digest.

X1.why: Radar board is readable but the top story is not immediately obvious without scanning multiple cards.

X2.why: Digest mixes synthesis (e.g., author-quality inference) with facts without consistently labeling subjective claims as model opinion.

X3.why: Digest commit was 6.0 hours before run time (2026-07-02T18:07Z → 2026-07-03T00:10Z).

X4.why: All URLs were reachable in this run; pipeline should still guard against single feed failures via per-source error isolation.

X5.why: Repo structure separates collection, distillation, and rendering; portfolio reads raw GitHub content and can be regenerated independently.
